# lbweb.uk - The Portfolio of Lewis ███████

> lbweb.uk is the personal portfolio for Lewis ███████, showcasing their photography, publications, and photographic albums. 

Key Details:

- Publications include any document published by Lewis, and lecture notes from A-Level Chemistry, Physics, and Statistics. 
- Photographs are also available at @lb.photography.gb on Instagram
- The website contains a blog maintained by Lewis containing anything and everything that comes to mind.
- The website also contains an about me page.
- Photographic Albums contain photos from the main photography section, however grouped into either date, location, event, etc.

All content is licensed under the Creative Commons BY-NC-ND 4.0 deed unless otherwise stated.
The website is powered by GoHugo using the Blowfish theme. Everything is visible on Lewis' GitHub page, and pushes to the website are handled by a GitHub worker.
You can contact Lewis via contactme@lbweb.uk

## Sections

- [About Me Page](https://lbweb.uk/aboutme): Lewis' About Me Page
- [Publications](https://lbweb.uk/publications): Lewis' Publications, including A-Level notes
- [Photographs](https://lbweb.uk/photography): Lewis' Photography, also found at @lb.photography.gb on Instagram
- [Blog](https://lbweb.uk/blog): Lewis' Blog
- [Privacy Policy](https://lbweb.uk/privacy-policy/): Privacy Policy
